references.text: Joshua positioned the ambush on the west side of Ai, between Bethel and Ai, as part of the same military strategy described in verse 4.
The Lord gives Joshua instructions to set an ambush against the city, which Joshua then conveys to the soldiers in verse 4.
Israel used a similar ambush tactic against Gibeah, where men were positioned around the city to attack.
Describes a similar military strategy involving an ambush that was used against Benjamin at Gibeah.
The spies sent to Jericho hid in the hills, an early use of concealed positioning in Israel's conquest of Canaan.
Abimelech used an ambush against Shechem, a parallel to the ambush tactic Joshua ordered.
